title: API Management
description: Manage external system access to KSM knowledge services, including API keys, authorization boundaries, endpoint usage, and integration examples.

auth.title: Authentication
auth.description: External systems should call KSM with an API Key. Prefer the Bearer header; x-api-key is accepted for compatibility.
auth.readDescription: Search, list knowledge bases, read notes, read graph data, and poll job status.
auth.writeDescription: Includes read access and can ingest documents, sync, reindex, update metadata, and delete notes.

apiKeys.title: External API Keys
apiKeys.description: Issue keys for external systems and restrict them to selected knowledge bases and scopes.

create.name: Name
create.noInstances: Create a knowledge base before authorizing an API key.

secret.description: For security, this plaintext key is only shown once.
secret.warning: After closing this dialog, the full key cannot be viewed again. Copy it now and keep it safe.
secret.failed: Copy failed. Please copy it manually.

edit.title: Edit API Key Permissions: {{name}}
edit.description: Adjust which knowledge bases this API key can access.
edit.noInstances: There are no knowledge bases to authorize yet.

confirm.rotate: Rotate this API key? The old key will stop working immediately.

quickStart.title: Recommended integration path
quickStart.description: Use search as the primary knowledge service entrypoint, then read notes or graph data only when the caller needs more context.

createKey.title: Create a key
createKey.description: Name it after the external system so rotation and auditing stay clear.

grant.title: Grant knowledge bases
grant.description: Authorize only the instances this system actually needs.

search.title: Call search
search.description: Start with POST /search for most knowledge-service requests.

read.title: Read details
read.description: Fetch notes, facets, stats, or graph data when richer context is needed.

write.title: Write when trusted
write.description: Use write keys for internal systems that ingest or maintain content.

catalog.title: External service endpoints
catalog.description: These are the API Key-accessible endpoints external systems should use. Admin auth, API Key management, and LLM settings endpoints are intentionally excluded.
catalog.errorDescription: 401 means the API key is missing or invalid; 403 means scope or knowledge-base authorization is insufficient; 404 means the target resource does not exist; 409 means a write job conflict.

search.title: Search knowledge across authorized instances
search.description: Primary entrypoint for external systems that need answers or relevant knowledge cards.
search.detail: Body supports query, instance_ids, layer_filter, verification_filter, and include_comprehension. Use it for fast node retrieval.

searchAnswer.title: Generate knowledge synthesis
searchAnswer.description: Returns an LLM-generated answer from knowledge maps and cards with source-note citations.
searchAnswer.detail: Uses map_card_first strategy. Source notes are citation targets, not the default reading material.

searchAnswerJob.title: Start synthesis job
searchAnswerJob.description: Starts answer generation and returns a job_id for progress tracking.
searchAnswerJob.detail: Use this for UI workflows that need visible map discovery, card reading, citation tracing, and synthesis steps.

searchAnswerJobStatus.title: Get synthesis job status
searchAnswerJobStatus.description: Polls steps, warnings, and the final answer result.
searchAnswerJobStatus.detail: Jobs are in-memory runtime state and may expire after completion.

searchAnswerJobSse.title: Stream synthesis job events
searchAnswerJobSse.description: Streams answer generation progress as server-sent events.
searchAnswerJobSse.detail: Events include step updates, thought summaries, citation trace updates, completion, and failure.

instanceList.title: List authorized knowledge bases
instanceList.description: Returns only the instances the API Key is allowed to access.
instanceList.detail: Use this to discover instance IDs before search, note reads, graph reads, or ingest.

instanceDetail.title: Get knowledge base details
instanceDetail.description: Returns metadata for one authorized knowledge base.
instanceDetail.detail: Requires instance access. API Keys cannot use admin-only create, update, or delete instance endpoints.

instanceStats.title: Get knowledge base statistics
instanceStats.description: Returns note counts, verification distribution, domain distribution, relation count, and last ingest time.
instanceStats.detail: Useful for monitoring whether an external integration is reading from a populated and recently updated instance.

noteList.title: List notes
noteList.description: Lists indexed notes with optional filters and lightweight search.
noteList.detail: Supports type, domain, kind, graph_layer, verification, and q query parameters.

noteFacets.title: List note facets
noteFacets.description: Returns normalized metadata facets for building external filters.
noteFacets.detail: Use this before note list calls when the external UI needs valid domain, kind, or verification filter values.

noteDetail.title: Get note detail
noteDetail.description: Returns frontmatter and Markdown body for a single note path.
noteDetail.detail: The path segment should be URL-encoded when it contains spaces, slashes, or non-ASCII characters.

noteVerification.title: Update note verification
noteVerification.description: Changes the manual review state of one note.
noteVerification.detail: Requires write scope. Allowed values are verified, unverified, and draft.

noteMetadata.title: Update note metadata
noteMetadata.description: Updates editable frontmatter fields for one note.
noteMetadata.detail: Requires write scope. Supports domain, kind, and verification; blank domain or kind removes that field.

noteDelete.title: Delete note
noteDelete.description: Deletes the note file and removes its indexed data.
noteDelete.detail: Requires write scope and instance authorization. There is no recycle bin in this MVP.

graph.title: Read graph
graph.description: Returns graph nodes and edges for an authorized knowledge base.
graph.detail: Supports layer_filter, domain_filter, verification_filter, and include_unresolved query parameters.

ingest.title: Synchronous ingest
ingest.description: Uploads one Markdown file and waits for the ingest pipeline response.
ingest.detail: Requires write scope. Use async ingest for larger files or UI workflows that need progress updates.

ingestAsync.title: Asynchronous ingest
ingestAsync.description: Uploads one Markdown file and returns a job_id immediately.
ingestAsync.detail: Requires write scope. Pair with job status polling or SSE for progress tracking.

jobStatus.title: Get ingest job status
jobStatus.description: Polls the current state, step progress, created files, generated cards, maps, and warnings.
jobStatus.detail: Requires read access to the instance. Jobs are in-memory runtime state and may expire after completion.

jobSse.title: Stream ingest job events
jobSse.description: Streams real-time ingest progress as server-sent events.
jobSse.detail: Requires read access to the instance. Use this for external dashboards that show live ingest progress.

jobCancel.title: Cancel ingest job
jobCancel.description: Requests cancellation for a pending or running ingest job.
jobCancel.detail: Requires write scope. Completed, failed, or already cancelled jobs cannot be cancelled again.

sync.title: Sync from local vault
sync.description: Scans the knowledge base vault for filesystem changes and updates the index.
sync.detail: Requires write scope. Optional git=true pulls from remote before syncing.

reindex.title: Rebuild index
reindex.description: Reindexes notes and relations for one knowledge base.
reindex.detail: Requires write scope. Use when external maintenance has changed files or index consistency is suspect.
